Fragrance
Perfume gift sets and discovery sets

Perfume gift sets make giving easy: a full bottle with a travel spray, a matching body lotion or a box of minis to explore. This edit brings together 72 sets and miniatures from Gucci, Dolce & Gabbana, Chloé, Bvlgari, Guerlain and more.

Full bottles with extras

The Gucci Bloom Eau de Parfum Gift Set (£84.99) pairs a 100 ml bottle with a 10 ml spray and body lotion, and Guilty Pour Femme comes with a matching body lotion (£47.99). Chloé Nomade (£66.99) adds a 20 ml travel spray to a 75 ml bottle. For him, the Dolce & Gabbana K gift set (£54.99) and Bvlgari Man Wood Essence (£64.99) both include a travel size. For her, Bvlgari Rose Goldea Blossom Delight (£79.99) is radiant and feminine, and the Dolce & Gabbana The One gift set for women (£64.99) holds two 50 ml bottles.

Minis and discovery sets

A discovery set is perfect when you're not sure of someone's taste. Chopard Gardens of Paradise (4 x 10 ml, £59.99) holds four unisex scents, and Mon Guerlain (4 x 5 ml, £44.99) offers four women's fragrances. The Gucci Flora Gorgeous Miniature Perfume Set (3 x 5 ml, £44.99) and the Dolce & Gabbana Men's Miniature Fragrance Set (£34.99) are lovely to unwrap. anatomē's Parfum Travel (£125) is a discovery set for travel.

Small but special

Single minis work as add-ons or stocking fillers. Calvin Klein My Euphoria (10 ml, £18.99) and Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid (10 ml, £17.99) both start under £20.

For more ideas, see travel size and mini perfumes, Christmas gifts and Gifts & Sets. Every set is 100% authentic and shipped from within the UK, with free delivery over £40.

Finding gifts for her is easier when everything is ready to wrap. This edit gathers 112 skincare sets, perfumes and calming extras for birthdays, anniversaries and thank-yous, from designer fragrance to natural skincare.

Skincare sets

Highborn London's Ultimate Day & Night Moisture Set (£95) covers morning and evening, the Scrub and Glow Luminosity Set (£89) brings two natural products for brighter-looking skin, and the Revive and Defy Starter Set (£78) pairs two of the brand's original formulas.

A perfume gift set adds a little extra. Chloé Nomade comes with a 20 ml travel spray (£66.99), and the DKNY Be Delicious & Be Delicious Fresh Blossom set (2 x 30 ml, £41.99) gives her two scents. If you're not sure of her taste, the Calvin Klein Women's Miniature Fragrance Set (4 x 15 ml, £33.99) lets her explore. Single bottles to consider include My Burberry Black Parfum (50 ml, £48.99), Ariana Grande Thank U, Next (£43.99) and Anna Sui Sky (30 ml, £18.99).

anatomē's The Little Gift of Good Sleep (£35) features a 10 ml Somali Frankincense sleep oil, and The Gift of Good Sleep (£68) adds a Somali Frankincense pillow spray. For a small luxury, Jean Paul Gaultier Classique Perfumed Shower Gel (£22.99) brings a favourite scent to the shower.

Gifts for him

Good gifts for him are the ones he'll actually use, from a signature scent to the grooming basics he keeps running out of. This edit gathers more than 70 perfumes, gift sets and practical extras for birthdays, Father's Day and every occasion in between.

Fragrance gift sets

A men's gift set gives him more than one bottle to enjoy. The Azzaro The Most Wanted Eau de Toilette Intense Gift Set (100 ml + 2 x 10 ml, £68.99) is fresh and sensual, and the Dolce & Gabbana K Eau de Parfum Gift Set (50 ml + 5 ml, £54.99) is confident and modern. The Dolce & Gabbana Men's Miniature Fragrance Set (£34.99) holds five scents, ideal if you're not sure what he wears.

Signature scents

For a full bottle, Dolce & Gabbana The One for Men Eau de Parfum Intense (£54.99) is deep and warm, Chopard Oud Malaki (£48.99) is rich and sophisticated, and John Varvatos Artisan (£32.99) is fresh and refined. Joop Homme Le Parfum (£32.99) is rich and sensual. Calvin Klein Eternity Parfum comes as a 10 ml miniature (£18.99), a nice small extra.

Practical extras

Grooming gifts don't need to be boring. Philipp Plein No Limits After Shave Balm (£23.99) is a smooth aftershave balm, and the matching Deodorant Stick (£16.99) completes the set. Coach Green Shower Gel (£13.99) is a refreshing men's shower gel, and Azzaro Pour Homme Deodorant Spray (£22.99) is a classic.

Stocking fillers under £15

Stocking fillers should be small, useful and a little bit lovely. This edit gathers 49 lip balms, soaps, scrubs and mini essentials, all under £15, so you can fill a stocking without going over budget.

Lips and face

Lip care is the classic small gift. Deyga's Beetroot Lip Balm Classic (£10.99) gives a soft tint with natural butters, Vilvah's Grape Fruit Lip Balm costs £6.99, and the Strawberry Lip Scrub (£10.99) buffs lips smooth. For the face, Deyga's Pure Rose Water Toner (£11.99) is a gentle rose water toner free from alcohol, and Vilvah's Wild Rose Face Mask (£11.99) uses French pink clay.

Bath and body

A goat milk soap is a simple, pretty gift. The Classic Goatmilk Soap Bar (£9.99) hydrates dry skin, and the Cucumber, Curd & Mint Soap Bar (£9.99) feels cool and refreshing. Deyga's Organic Loofah (£12.99) is a natural exfoliating tool, and Coach Green Shower Gel (£13.99) is a refreshing men's body wash.

Handy extras

Vilvah's Deo Shot comes in Lavender & Sage and Rose & Vanilla (£9.99 each), a natural deodorant in a compact 20 g size. Deyga's Hair Removal Powder (£13.99) is a natural hair removal powder, and Vilvah's Men's Neem Wood Comb (£9.99) is handmade from neem wood.

For bigger budgets, see gifts under £25 and Christmas gifts, or shop the full Under £15 range. Swansura is an official UK partner of Deyga and Vilvah. Every product is 100% authentic and ships from the UK, and orders over £40 get free delivery.
